about: One-frame event of esv::interrupt::EventSystem: the roll adjustments an interrupt applied to a conditional roll. Filled by the named Toolkit functions esv::interrupt::FillRollAdjustmentEvent(eoc::interrupt::ConditionalRollEvent const&, eoc::interrupt::AppliedChange const&, ConditionalRollAdjustmentOneFrameComponent&) (EoCServer.dll+0x10D1150) and FillEmptyRollAdjustmentEvent (EoCServer.dll+0x10D1130): the event's two roll Guids, roll index and passive, then the AppliedChange's roll adjustments (a copy of the SE struct interrupt::RollAdjustments, Interrupt.h) at +0x30. Never seen alive. Registry total 136 (server row).

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x357DC00 (AllocRaw 0x88) zeroes +0..+0x27; FillRollAdjustmentEvent copies ConditionalRollEvent+0x10 (SE Interrupt.h ConditionalRollEvent.RollUuid2) to +0/+8.
Creator writes 0xffc0000000000000 at +0x28; Fill copies ConditionalRollEvent+0x28 (SE Passive).
Creator zeroes the dword at +0x30; copy EoCServer.dll+0x10CCB10 `*param_1 = *param_2` (SE RollAdjustments.BaseAdjustment).

Creator zeroes +0x38/+0x40/+0x44 (Array); copy +8 of RollAdjustments with 0x14-byte elements (SE names this array FixedRollBonuses, but the Toolkit's element type is eoc::interrupt::RollAdjustmentMetadata).
Creator zeroes +0x48 and the byte +0x4C; copy moves the qword +0x18 of RollAdjustments (SE std::optional<int> FixedAdjustment: value then has-value flag).
Creator zeroes the byte +0x50; copy `*(undefined1 *)(param_1 + 8) = ...` (RollAdjustments+0x20, SE RerollType).
Creator zeroes +0x58/+0x60/+0x64; copy allocates (count, 2, 1) for RollAdjustments+0x28.
Creator zeroes +0x68/+0x70/+0x74; copy allocates (count, 2, 1) for RollAdjustments+0x38.
Creator zeroes +0x78 and the byte +0x7C; copy moves the qword +0x48 of RollAdjustments (SE std::optional<int> ResolvedRoll).
Creator zeroes the byte +0x80; copy moves RollAdjustments+0x50 (SE UseMaxRoll).

survey.live_reason: no live or captured instance: needs a situation that creates it
open_questions: Names follow SE's ConditionalRollEvent / RollAdjustments (Interrupt.h); the Metadata array is what SE calls FixedRollBonuses - its 20-byte element is RollAdjustmentMetadata by the Toolkit, not SE's 24-byte FixedRollBonus.
Element strides of the two reroll arrays come from the Toolkit copy (agreeing with the bg3.exe creator and the registry size).
Not seen alive (seen.py has no samples).
